title: Paxos theme
description: A calm, regulated-finance light theme: white page, deep blue-green slate ink and pill buttons, neutral grey secondary text, cool pale-grey media frames and near-white blue-grey cards behind thin hairlines, with a faint aqua-to-lime wash as the only colour. Hanken Grotesk titles over Geist body text, 8px corners, no shadows. A deep slate dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in the same spirit (slate page, same aqua and lime lights)
--glow is the aqua light and --highlight the lime light of the hero and closing washes
